disposition_reason: Reports lead, cadmium, zinc, copper, iron and manganese concentrations by ICP-MS in leafy vegetables, tomatoes and soft fruits grown in Warsaw allotment gardens and in control gardens.

study.design: cross-sectional survey of allotment-garden produce with a rural control
study.origin: 16 allotment gardens in Warsaw, Poland; control gardens in agricultural areas 60 km from Warsaw
study.method: washed, dried at 60 then 105 C, dry ashed at 480 C, HCl dissolution, ICP-MS (US EPA 6020B)
study.qa: Certified reference materials (Montana soil, tobacco) used; recoveries not reported; duplicate analyses; accredited laboratory

unresolved: Table 2 cherries Cu mean 5.90 is below the printed min 8.10 (flagged).
Table 2 control fruits Fe min 15 exceeds max 10 (flagged).
Table 3 lettuce location n values (22, 16, 15) sum to 53, but Table 1 gives 33 lettuce samples.
Pb and Cd in fruits printed only as "LOD"; LOD units printed as "µg L-1 lub µg kg-1 DM" (Polish "lub" = or), so the exact LOD per matrix is unclear.
Tomatoes are grouped in Table 1 under leafy vegetables; results are dry-weight and not converted to fresh weight.
